t: This is Judith Kerr Primary School, a school in Herne Hill, named after the writer and illustrator Judith Kerr. Her books have sold more than ten million copies around the world. She created picture books like the Mog series and The Tiger Who Came to Tea, and also wrote When Hitler Stole Pink Rabbit, a semi-autobiographical novel that gives a child's-eye view of escaping Nazi persecution. Born in Germany, she came to Britain with her family in 1935. It's a fitting name for a place full of children and stories.
